subject: Sunsetting Outreach: data export, final billing & decommission timeline
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@outreach.com>, Outreach Billing <accounts@useoutreach.com>
Date: 2029-02-14T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Sunsetting Outreach: data export, final billing & decommission timeline

Team / Sam —

Quick summary: after the pilot evaluation and cost review, we've decided to fully sunsetting our Outreach instance and consolidate sequences into HubSpot + Salesforce workflows. Before we start the migration, we need firm answers on exportability, retention, and billing proration. Specific asks: 

- Can Outreach provide a full export of: sequences (including blocks/states), cadence performance metrics, individual activity logs, and attachments (email templates, attachments references) in machine-readable format?
- What is your formal cancellation window and last-bill proration calculation if termination effective 2029-03-31?
- Any steps required to disable SSO/SCIM and confirm account deprovisioning for our org?

Attached is a current account snapshot (outreach_subscr_account_snapshot.csv) and an inventory of sequences we care most about. Please confirm what you can export as-is and any data gaps we should expect. 

Goal timeline (internal):
- 2029-02-20: Outreach confirms export format and cancellation terms
- 2029-02-28: Redwood sends formal termination notice / DocuSign
- 2029-03-15: Data export delivered and validated
- 2029-03-31: Final billing cutoff / instance disabled

Marissa/Ben — please confirm the list attached maps to the sequences we need to prioritize for migration. Kimberly — please flag any security/compliance items you need from Outreach. Sam — appreciate a clear export checklist and lead time so we can align.

Thanks,
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@outreach.com>
Date: 2029-02-14T10:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sunsetting Outreach: data export, final billing & decommission timeline

On Wed, Feb 14, 2029 at 9:02 AM Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team / Sam —
> 
> Quick summary: after the pilot evaluation and cost review, we've decided to fully sunsetting our Outreach instance and consolidate sequences into HubSpot + Salesforce workflows. ...

Thanks Vivek — added the SDR perspective below. A few clarifications from ops: 

- Priority sequences: outbound-inbound-onboarding, renewals-ops, enterprise-accts. These are the ones with reporting dashboards we cannot lose. See attached sdr_sequences_inventory.xlsx with mapping to HubSpot lists.
- We need cadence state history (who was in which step at export time) — not just the template content. If we lose state we have to rehydrate cadence progress manually which will be messy for mid-funnel accounts.
- Sequence-level analytics: open rates, reply rates, touch-by-touch timestamps (we use these in our forecasting models). Is that part of the standard export?

If Outreach can provide logs with ISO timestamps and message IDs we can map to HubSpot engagement objects. Also: any automation that is live (hooks/webhooks) — we need a list so we can pause safely.

Ben Carter
SDR Systems Lead
Redwood Inference

Attachment: sdr_sequences_inventory.xlsx
From: Sam Walters <sam.walters@outreach.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2029-02-15T08:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sunsetting Outreach: data export, final billing & decommission timeline

Vivek / team —

Thanks for the heads-up and the attachments. I'll summarize what Outreach can deliver and our standard process. Short answer: yes, we can export the items you listed, but some elements require extra configuration and lead time. Details below.

What we can provide (standard export package):
- Sequence templates (JSON) including steps, wait rules, and templates.
- Per-contact cadence state (CSV) with step index, last_step_at, and next_scheduled_at.
- Activity logs (CSV) with timestamps, activity type, message_id references.
- Message templates and attachment pointers (attachments are provided as filename references; we will package binary attachments in a ZIP upon request).

Non-standard / extra work items:
- Historical performance rollups (aggregates per sequence per quarter) require an analytics export job (additional 3–5 business days).
- Raw webhook payloads: only available if you retain our webhook logs for the retention period; otherwise they are not exportable after 90 days.

Billing & cancellation:
- Notice window: 30 days prior to the renewal date. Given your current contract, term end is 2029-03-31; formal written termination by 2029-02-28 will avoid an auto-renewal for the next period.
- Final invoice: prorated based on days used in the final month; any pre-paid overage credit will be applied to diminish the final charge. I can loop in billing to confirm numbers once you confirm the exact termination date.

SSO/SCIM:
- Standard offboarding checklist: disable SCIM provisioning, revoke SAML certificates, and then request org suspension. We will keep a 7-day soft-window to allow admin recovery.

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm which sequences (names/IDs) are priority by 2029-02-18.
2) I kick off the export job for the standard package (3 business days).
3) If you want analytics rollups, confirm by 2029-02-18 (extra 3–5 business days).

I'll attach the export instructions and an estimate for the analytic export.

— Sam Walters
Customer Success Manager — Outreach

Attachment: outreach_data_export_instructions.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@outreach.com>, Outreach Billing <accounts@useoutreach.com>
Date: 2029-02-15T12:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sunsetting Outreach: data export, final billing & decommission timeline

Thanks Sam — that checklist is helpful. A couple of operational notes from our side: 

- Confirmed priority sequences (IDs and friendly names attached in sdr_sequences_inventory.xlsx). Ben will own validation of cadence state and replay mapping.
- Legal will prepare the formal termination notice. I'll ask Legal to route the DocuSign to Outreach billing and account exec for signature. Draft sent to Legal for review; plan to send DocuSign on 2029-02-28 as Vivek requested.
- Kimberly: please advise on retention requirements. We need to keep message content for 24 months for compliance audits; ask Outreach to preserve a snapshot for eDiscovery for an extra 30 days after deletion if possible.

Sam, can you confirm: if we request the analytics rollup we will need delivery by 2029-03-15 latest so our analytics team can ingest before the cutover. Also confirm the format of attachments in the ZIP (preserve original filenames + timestamps).

Marissa Cole
Head of Customer Success
Redwood Inference

DocuSign draft link: https://app.docusign.com/DocuSign/launch?doc=XYZ-termination
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Sam Walters <sam.walters@outreach.com>, Outreach Billing <accounts@useoutreach.com>
Date: 2029-02-16T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Sunsetting Outreach: data export, final billing & decommission timeline

Appreciate the quick responses. Finalizing next actions here so owners are clear: 

Action items: 
- Sam / Outreach: kick off standard export job upon confirmation; analytics rollup (optional) if we confirm by 2029-02-18. Deliverables: export package (JSON/CSV) + attachments ZIP. Owner: Sam. Due: 2029-03-15 (accepted delivery).
- Ben: validate cadence state mapping and provide a signed-off sample by 2029-03-01 so we can test import playbook. Owner: Ben Carter.
- Kimberly: confirm retention/eDiscovery requests to Sam and Legal by 2029-02-20. Owner: Kimberly Park.
- Marissa / Legal: send DocuSign termination notice on 2029-02-28 (Vivek to approve prior to send). Owner: Marissa Cole.
- Finance: (cc'd internally) expect final prorated invoice; Sam please include a provisional estimate and any credits Outlook will apply.

Risk notes:
- If analytics rollup is delayed we risk not having historical KPIs in time for Q2 forecasting.
- If webhook logs are older than 90 days we may lose some automation payloads — recommend capturing any retained logs immediately.

Sam — if Outreach can provide a one-month trial credit tied to migration timing it will help with the final month’s unit economics; not required but helpful.

I'll approve the DocuSign draft once Legal gives the green light. Thanks everyone.

Vivek
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference
